# Sew client crates vendored for K2 (S30 K15)

Source:    Alakazam-211/sew, branch release-0.3.0 @ 8252db23
           (= Sew core v0.3.0, the release K2 0.46.3 pins; main a9e7734e + version bump)
Crates:    sew-proto 0.3.0, sew-client 0.3.0 (Apache-2.0; LICENSE and NOTICE inside each crate)
Packed by: Sew's own scripts/vendor-sew-proto.sh at that commit (cargo package, then its
           byte-stable python packer: sorted entries, owner 0:0, modes 0644/0755, mtime 0,
           gzip without name or time). Run on macOS 2026-10-20 with the script's GNU `touch -d @0`
           line neutralised (BSD touch refuses it; the python packer sets every mtime itself).
Tarballs (sha256, verified before unpacking):
  ce5b97259b7120608066366041aa15b9721643d208baecabaac9d952641042f3  sew-proto-0.3.0.tar.gz
  f29103ac6afc4236748fb935fcb7a3960a9d1b3d7fd26ee2e98bc9832bf0bae2  sew-client-0.3.0.tar.gz
Unpacked byte-for-byte into third_party/sew-proto and third_party/sew-client. No K2 edits.

There is no vendoring tag for 0.3.0 yet (the newest are sew-proto-v0.1.0-sw2 /
sew-client-v0.1.0-sw2, which are Sew 0.1.0). Mac and Linux runs of the script can differ: the
same script on the -sw2 tag gave sew-proto 373082cf... on this Mac against Sew's published
e6b28157... (most likely the Cargo.lock `cargo package` writes for sew-proto, resolved against
each machine's registry cache). ASK SEW to confirm these two hashes from its Linux run, or to
cut sew-proto-v0.3.0 / sew-client-v0.3.0 vendoring tags; if theirs differ, re-vendor from their
tarballs and regenerate this file.

Wiring: the workspace root patches `sew-proto = { path = "third_party/sew-proto" }`
([patch.crates-io]); k2-daemon depends on sew-client by path with
default-features = false, features = ["mgmt", "sync"] (no gateway). Both crates are listed in
the workspace `exclude`, so K2's lints and members never apply to them.

Check: k2-daemon's test `sew_chat::client::tests::vendored_sew_crates_match_the_manifest`
recomputes every file below and fails on any changed, missing or extra file.
To re-vendor: unpack the new tarballs over these two directories, then rewrite the manifest
(one `sha256  path` line per file, sorted by path, paths relative to third_party/).

S27's TEMP mirrors (crates/k2-core/src/tool_hook/sew_wire.rs, crates/k2-daemon/src/sew/sew_wire.rs)
are not swapped to these types yet (K1).
